input: Apply for a library card at the local branch

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which specific library branch or system determines the exact application process, required documents, and whether online pre-registration is available.
Whether the card is for themselves, a child, or multiple family members changes the requirements — minors often need a guardian's signature and different ID.
The user's available proof of address and ID affects whether they can apply immediately or need to gather documents first.
Whether the library allows online, phone, or only in-person applications changes the immediate next action and how much travel is required.
Some libraries offer different card tiers (e.g., digital-only vs. full borrowing privileges), so knowing what the user wants to use the card for shapes which type to apply for.
Knowing the user's deadline or urgency (e.g., needs it this week for a specific purpose) affects how to prioritise steps and whether expedited options matter.
Whether the user wants a step-by-step checklist, a quick summary, or help filling out forms shapes how the plan should be presented.

questions.title: Which library system or branch are you applying to?
questions.description: Identifies the specific library, which determines the exact application process, required documents, and available channels.

questions.title: Who is the library card for — you, a child, or family?
questions.description: Determines whether adult, minor, or family membership rules apply, as requirements differ significantly.

questions.title: What ID or proof of address do you currently have on hand?
questions.description: Establishes whether the user is ready to apply now or needs to gather documents first.

questions.title: Can your library accept applications online, or must you go in person?
questions.description: Shapes the immediate next action — whether the user visits the branch or completes a digital form.

questions.title: What do you mainly plan to borrow — physical books, e-books, other materials?
questions.description: Helps identify if a specific card type or membership tier is needed for the intended use.

questions.title: Do you need the card by a specific date or for a particular reason?
questions.description: Determines urgency and whether any expedited or temporary card options should be included in the plan.

questions.title: Do you prefer a step-by-step checklist or a brief action summary?
questions.description: Tailors the format and level of detail of the final plan to the user's preference.
